# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** Approximately eleven or twelve years old  <sub>[v2 c27 P61](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, United States  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric is a handsome and youthful boy with brown curls. He closely resembles his father, Stephen Stanhope. He wears an elegant small fur cap and coat.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028), [v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026)_

## Personality

Cedric is an extraordinarily imaginative, solemn, and affectionate boy who speaks with remarkable gravity. Despite his rich inner world of fantasy and creative fancies, he possesses a strong sense of manliness, holds his own in games, and stands up for his convictions.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P31](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0031), [v2 c27 P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

## Traits

- Imaginative  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c27 P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)</sub>
- Manly  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
- Solemn  <sub>[v2 c23 P31](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0031)</sub>

## Abilities

- Creating imaginary rock people and dream stories  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>

## History

Cedric moved from Boston to live with his grandmother on the shore road in Brierley. At school, he became a beloved student of Nell Harcourt, who appreciated his rich imagination and unique personality. He shared letters with Nell detailing his imaginary stone companions by the beach, such as Nora, the Twin Sailors, and the Golden Lady. He also engaged in a friendly fight with St. Clair Trask regarding their respective national flags. Nell brought Cedric to visit Miss Rosalind Penrose at her stone house, where Cedric quickly bonded with her over shared fancies of dream-people. When his father, Stephen Stanhope, unexpectedly arrived in town, Cedric warmly introduced him to Nell, ultimately helping to rekindle the relationship between his father and Miss Rosalind.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034), [v2 c27 P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026), [v3 c31 P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Lived in Boston prior to moving to Brierley to stay with his grandmother  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- Son of Stephen Stanhope and his late wife  <sub>[v2 c21 P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084)</sub>
